2034-5189-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-5189-7824.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-6248--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3652-3899.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-3899.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2793-3632-4241-7714.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
When Ugin's Nexus enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Ugin's Nexus to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, choosing not to pay and return Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4091-4747-7791.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
4091-4747-7791.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Alena.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Alena.
Repeat.

215-1526-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-5295.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5178-5759-7711.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
You control a creature that has indestructible.
5178-5759-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Odric.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5178-5759-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3899-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

321-399-2475-4908-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-1170-1329-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1594-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
1594-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

3284-3490-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2292-3174-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2079-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

360-560-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
360-560-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1836-4423-5948-6618.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1836-4423-5948-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Relm's Sketching from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Activate the original Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 4.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

4826-5222-5686-6644.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

277-1315-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-1315-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

2018-3826-5231.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-3826-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Medicine Runner, adding {R}.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Repeat.

2061-2103-2493.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-2493.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

940-1857-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
940-1857-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

618-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nonlegendary non-Human creature.
You control at least one creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and that does not have summoning sickness.
618-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary non-Human creature you control with haste that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat.

933-1558-4840-5085.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Thopter Spy Network's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Thopter and the four Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1984-5016-5109.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Spitemare and you, with Angel's Grace causing your life total to become one instead.
Spitemare triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

341-3831-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Circuit Mender, adding {C}{C}.
When Circuit Mender dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Circuit Mender on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Circuit Mender trigger, causing you to draw Circuit Mender.
Cast Circuit Mender by paying {2}.
When Circuit Mender enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

2634-2928-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2634-2928-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1751-2743-4615.description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Quasiduplicate twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quasiduplicates, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1312-3770-4050-4068.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gixian Puppeteer, adding {B}.
When Gixian Puppeteer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Gixian Puppeteer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2837-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2837-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

11-1484-2196.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
11-1484-2196.description:
Activate Primal Wellspring and the two additional lands by tapping them, adding {1}{U}{U} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Primal Wellspring's ability triggers, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping Primal Wellspring and the two other lands.
Activate Primal Wellspring and those two lands, adding at least {1}{U}{U} and creating another delayed triggered ability.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Frantic Search.
Primal Wellspring's ability triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the new copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning the original Frantic Search to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping Primal Wellspring and two other lands.
Repeat.
